study type: Secondary data analysis of a prospective cohort study
finding: No direct association was found between mode of delivery and child behavior problems at 2-3 years of age; however, emergency cesarean section was indirectly linked to increased child behavior problems through the mediating pathway of maternal PTSD and PPD.
mod_finding: While no direct link was observed between delivery mode and child behavior, the study found a significant indirect effect of emergency C-section on child behavior problems, mediated by maternal PTSD and PPD.
